criteria_note: Scores 0-10 per eval/ARTIFACT_RUBRIC.md (A-F, G, X1, review R1-R3); claims sampled across each post (>=20, >=8 numbers) against the arXiv HTML v3

A.reason: Claim-style noun-phrase headings in a clear arc (problem -> derivation -> loss -> PPO analysis -> pipeline -> experiments -> judge validation -> samples -> limitations); no 초록 section; valid front matter (description 134 chars, use_math). Nit: L153 copies a '\\' line break into single-line $$ display math without an environment.

B.reason: Natural 입니다 prose. L245 '저자들이 따로 언급하지 않은 실험의 기본 설정' calques 'unless noted otherwise' and reads as 'experiments the authors did not mention' -> '따로 밝히지 않은 경우의 기본 설정'. L255 meta '참고문헌에 올라 있고'. Mixed term forms: '브래들리-테리' (L43) vs 'Bradley-Terry 대입' heading (L115), gloss given only at L121.

C.reason: Running example breaks: L43/L97 set up an unnamed hypothetical, then L147 '파스타 질문 쌍에 대입해 보겠습니다', L158, L191 '체중 감량을 가정한 요약' and L241 refer to the pasta post, which is introduced only at L362. Otherwise transitions use accurate back-references ('앞서 본 투영 f').

D.reason: Worked numbers at the hard points (L97 log-ratio 0.69, L147 loss 0.40, L158 weights 0.33/0.67, L241 loss 1.10, all arithmetic correct); equivalence classes explained briefly; easy parts not padded.

E.reason: 3 figures, the paper's code, CNN/DM table, sweep and hyperparameter tables. Missing where they clearly help: the TL;DR win-rate-vs-temperature and HH dialogue results are prose only; the human-study table (L336-340) gives sample counts but not the win/agreement numbers the section's conclusion (L354) rests on.

F.reason: Two cases: (1) L154 gradient weight sigma(r_hat(yw)-r_hat(yl)) contradicts the body form and the post's own L156 (copied from a typo in App. A.4); (2) L30/L297 claim dialogue parity with PPO though the paper only used Best of 128 as a proxy after the PPO HH model failed. All 20 other sampled claims, including 13 numbers, match.

R1.reason: Derivation, theory and PPO analysis are solid, but the dialogue section (L320-324) reports no outcome at all (no Pythia-2.8B, no 'only efficient method improving over chosen responses', no PPO-proxy explanation), the convergence result is absent, and the human study omits Table 2's numbers; the theorem/uniqueness statements are only paraphrased.

R2.reason: Intuition -> formula -> numeric example layering for the closed form, reparameterization, loss and gradient; length (19k chars) fits a moderately hard paper.

R3.reason: TL;DR concrete with models and settings; L380-391 is the writer's own assessment with specific unknowns. But L30 overstates the dialogue comparison, and L389 says over-optimization 'cannot be seen' although the paper flags the Fig. 3-right drop as a possible instance; the paper's own future-work items (automated evaluators, other modalities) are not mentioned.

G.reason: description 134 chars, starts with DPO, numbers 61%/57% from TL;DR; use_math true; https arXiv link; no Liquid or prompt tokens.

X1.reason: Category Finetuning; 'Alignment' controlled tag plus specific tags; 'Reward-Model-Reparameterization' and 'Implicit-Reward' overlap.
